description: For a learner doing attention-heavy work (reading, writing, problem solving, test preparation), a protected block with competing talk, notifications and avoidable interruptions removed is expected to lengthen on-task work and improve task performance compared with the same task amid ordinary distraction; no claim in the wiki tests this, and the nearest evidence is observational work on classroom conditions and surveys of study space and digital distraction.
title: Quiet Learning Spaces
